note: What the scan found, in words. One line per concern YouCam measured, banded from its raw_score. Raw values are read here and never shown: no numbers, scores or points reach the screen.
direction_note: YouCam raw_score is 1-100 and higher for healthier-looking skin on every concern (app/evidence.py MOVE_WORDS, needs.json concern_threshold_note). So for redness, acne, pore and oiliness a higher value means LESS of it; for moisture, radiance and texture a higher value means MORE of it (or smoother). Each concern's `higher_means` says which.
bands_note: Three bands per concern. `low` starts at 60 so it lines up with needs.json concern_threshold: a concern in the low band is the one that adds a need to the basket. `high` is 80 and above.
measured_by: Measured by YouCam AI Skin Analysis
